result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal restaurant carousel under 'Fastest near you' clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with no visual affordance (fade or peek padding) indicating scrollability, and the bottom navigation bar has a misaligned/overlapping search icon and home-indicator bar that look visually broken.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is hard-clipped at the right screen edge with its title and image cut off mid-character, giving no clear visual cue that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a gradient fade mask on the scroll container, and ensure the last visible card peeks partially with consistent spacing so users understand the row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the system home-indicator bar overlaps the search (magnifier) icon, making the icon appear struck-through and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Add safe-area bottom padding to the tab bar so the home indicator does not overlap the navigation icons, and vertically center the icons within the available space.

issues.description: The truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' uses an ellipsis that cuts the word awkwardly; combined with the edge clipping it reads as a rendering glitch rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with ellipsis within a fixed card width and ensure the card itself is fully or intentionally partially visible.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi'...) is also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade or padding to signal horizontal scrollability of the chip list, consistent with the restaurant carousel treatment.
